title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Tiger and Vanessa Talk Marriage
items.text: Tiger Woods and Vanessa Trump are reportedly very serious and discussing marriage while he plans his return to TGL season 3 in December.

items.headline: Yamashita Leads LPGA Malaysia
items.text: Miyu Yamashita shot 5-under 67 to lead the LPGA Maybank Championship at 18-under 198, two strokes ahead going into Sunday's final round.

items.headline: Koepka Enjoys Italy Offseason
items.text: Brooks Koepka shared a lighthearted moment with wife Jena Sims during their Tuscany vacation as he resets after a winless 2026 season before competing in TGL.
